answer: Each epoch demands a fresh attestation from the issuer, and stale or copied records fail the check. Use curling club membership with bonspiel entry records as the proof: bonspiels entered under one club for years. One fake is cheap, but 447 aliases need 447 independent entry records, and the time invested in each is the price the farm pays. Honesty stays cheap and fakery is priced per head: the summit signal is public, the grove check is automatic, and 447 aliases cost 447 times what one real agent costs, with the jetty trail open to all.
